yield_to_pots.label: Stop for Magic Pots
yield_to_pots.tooltip:
Pause farming while a Magic Pot is live or about to spawn and hand over to the automator's Pots & Treasure mode (lead time follows the automator's pot settings).
When the pot is done the automator is stopped and the farmer walks back to its spot.
Does nothing while the automator is already running.

yield_to_treasure_hunt.label: Treasure Hunt on a timer
yield_to_treasure_hunt.tooltip:
On the interval below, pause farming and run one Treasure Hunt, then walk back to the spot.
Only starts when remaining bronze/silver meets the minimum % on Treasure Hunter; needs a Treasure Sight reading.

treasure_hunt_interval_minutes.label: Treasure Hunt interval (minutes)
treasure_hunt_interval_minutes.tooltip: Minutes between timed hunts. The first one is due this long after you press Start.

yield_to_crystal_buffs.label: Refresh crystal buffs when low
yield_to_crystal_buffs.tooltip:
With the Buffs module enabled, return to base camp after a fight when a crystal buff is below its reapply time, then teleport and walk back to the spot.
Waits 5 minutes before another buff trip.

cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.label: Cast Treasure Sight at the farm spot
cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.tooltip:
Switch to Freelancer, cast Treasure Sight to refresh the coffer counts, then switch back.
Needs Freelancer 10+.

treasure_sight_interval_minutes.label: Treasure Sight interval (minutes)
treasure_sight_interval_minutes.tooltip:
0 = after every fight (the previous behaviour).
Above 0: cast on this interval, also while waiting for enemies.

claimed_spot_seconds.label: Leave a claimed spot after
claimed_spot_seconds.tooltip: If other players keep the current spot this long (every nearby enemy is fighting someone else, or a player stands on the farm or stack point), skip it for this run and go to the next spot.

claimed_player_radius.label: Claimed player radius
claimed_player_radius.tooltip: Treat the spot as claimed while another player is this close (yalms) to the farm or stack point.

count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.label: Count special enemies toward minimums
count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.tooltip:
On: special enemies count toward the start and fight minimums (the previous behaviour).
Off: special enemies are still pulled but do not count.

stacking_timeout_seconds.label: Gather / stack timeout
stacking_timeout_seconds.tooltip:
After gathering this long with enemies on you, start stacking; after walking to the stack point this long, start fighting.
0 = no limit (the previous behaviour).

use_ranged_pull.label: Ranged pull (tanks)
use_ranged_pull.tooltip: While gathering, tanks hit the enemy they are walking to with Shield Lob / Tomahawk / Unmend / Lightning Shot instead of walking into melee.

use_provoke.label: Use Provoke while pulling
use_provoke.tooltip: While gathering, tanks Provoke the enemy they are walking to.

use_gap_closer.label: Use a gap closer while pulling
use_gap_closer.tooltip: While gathering, tanks use Intervene / Onslaught / Shadowstride / Trajectory on the enemy they are walking to (Paladin, Warrior, Dark Knight, Gunbreaker only).

apply_ringing_respite.label: Use Ringing Respite
apply_ringing_respite.tooltip:
Before each pull, switch to Geomancer and cast Ringing Respite (needs Geomancer 3).
Until set, follows Use Battle Bell, as before.

apply_quickstep.label: Use Quickstep
apply_quickstep.tooltip: Before each pull, switch to Dancer and cast Quickstep (needs Dancer 2).

quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.label: Skip Quickstep if remaining (minutes)
quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.tooltip:
Skip Quickstep while the crystal Quicker Step still has at least this many minutes left.
0 = cast every pull.

apply_counterstance.label: Use Counterstance
apply_counterstance.tooltip: Last before each pull, switch to Monk and cast Counterstance for Fleetfooted (needs Monk 3); skipped while Fleetfooted is up.

spots.help: Start uses the highest-priority enabled spot of the current zone (nearest on a tie) and walks there first. With no spots the farmer works where you press Start. The stack point is optional, for caves and towers.
spots.add_here: Add current position as a spot
spots.empty: No spots: Start uses where you are standing.
spots.name: Name
spots.use_stack_tooltip: Stack the pack here instead of at the furthest enemy.
spots.set_stack: Set stack point to current position
